data.name: Maisie
data.long_meaning: The name Maisie is derived from the ancient Greek goddess name, Maia, who was the goddess of the moon, mountains and magic. In Roman mythology, she was also associated with the fertility of the land. The name Maisie came into popular use in England during the Middle Ages, where it was often given as a nickname for Margaret, meaning 'pearl' or 'mighty one.'
